prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production 2D pixel-art sprite atlas for Crown Pepe: One More Launch, taking the attached ship and Crown Pepe designs as design reference only. Critical requirement: each sprite is ONE INTEGRATED DRAWING of Crown Pepe tightly strapped to the OUTSIDE of a vertical emerald rocket. Do not draw separate character/ship assets. The frog must convincingly sit against the hull on a small bolted saddle: bent legs wrap either side, feet rest on metal footholds, a broad brown leather X harness crosses his black shirt and fastens to gold metal anchor bolts on the ship. Straps curve around his torso, compress costume, cast consistent contact shadows onto frog and metal; his hands grip two small side handles. Shared 3/4-front camera, consistent lighting and shading make frog and rocket a single believable designed object, not pasted together. Recognizable Crown Pepe: broad green frog face, heavy eyelids, orange lips, black shirt with green candlestick emblem, black shorts gold trim, small gold crown with emerald jewel. Ship black metal, gold trim, emerald crystal nose, crisp fins. Crown Pepe head should be about 1/4 whole rocket height, ship readable behind him. Exact 2x2 equal-cell sprite atlas with transparent background, landscape or square no labels. Four complete fully contained assembled rocket+rider sprites, same vertical orientation, centered within each cell with generous clear margins. TOP LEFT starter slim single-nozzle rocket with strapped Crown Pepe looking smug. TOP RIGHT SAME starter rocket and identical harness/registration/scale with Crown Pepe eyes wide mouth open in panic, hands still gripping handles, no flailing detached limbs. BOTTOM LEFT upgraded wider triple-engine rocket with attached side boosters and strapped smug Crown Pepe, integrated mounted desk-fan cooling module on one side. BOTTOM RIGHT exact SAME upgraded triple rocket with strapped terrified Crown Pepe. No flames or smoke (animated separately in engine), no ground, no UI, no written text, no logo. High-quality crisp handcrafted 32-bit pixel art, visible deliberate square pixel clusters, dark clean outlines, no smooth 3D rendering. All four sprites share gold/green material palette and matched camera and lighting; calm/panic versions differ only face/head expression. Keep entire sprites including crowns and nozzles inside their cell. Real alpha transparency.
notes: The main rig is rendered from ONE integrated sprite. The prior standalone pilot is used only during ejection/leaf-parachute recovery. No rider or harness is pasted onto the flight rig.
